messages:
Mia: kicking off SEA4 region bring-up. Plan: terraform for network/quota/project wiring, pulumi for cluster + node pools. aiming for smoke validation by EOD tomorrow. Need state/cicd plan.

Raj: tl;dr: yes. main questions: remote state backend? lock? bootstrap service account perms?

Mia: using GCS remote state with bucket redwood-infra-sea4-tf-state, locking via firestore/lock or use Cloud KMS? thinking use backend = "gcs" + statefile, and enable state locking with a tiny Cloud Spanner transaction (we actually use gcs + terraform lock via terraform-cloud is not an option). maybe we use "gcs" + remote locks via firebase? open to suggestions.

Jamie: we should avoid custom lock hacks. Keep Terraform state in GCS and use workarounds: enable object versioning and set IAM so CI uses single locked service account. Or run apply through our CICD that acquires a lock file in a dedicated locking bucket (infra-locks).

Lee: Pulumi stacks -> store secrets in KMS. Use Pulumi service backend? prefer self-hosted pulumi service pointing to Postgres. But faster: use Pulumi Cloud with env-managed token for now and export to private stack later. Also ensure Pulumi policy checks run in CICD.

Olivia: GPU SKUs for SEA4: only A10G and T4 available. Cost estimate shows A10G ~ $1.2/hour, T4 ~ $0.35/hour. For initial cluster we should use 2 T4 nodes (min) + 1 A10G for model-sim tests. Need quota request to cloud team; quota bump in progress but not guaranteed.

Mia: action items: 1) Raj - create TF modules for network + project + service accounts, bucket + IAM. 2) Jamie - pulumi stack for k8s cluster + node pools, with PV CSI drivers. 3) Lee - CICD pipeline YAML for monotonic apply + lock mechanism. 4) Olivia - submit quota request and confirm SKUs. I'll own validation runbook and handoff doc.

Raj: started a branch: gitlab.com/redwood/infra/sea4-wireup; pushed initial main.tf with module refs. note: using backend config: bucket=redwood-infra-terraform-state, prefix=sea4/network. CLI in CI: terraform init -backend-config=...; terraform apply -auto-approve.

Jamie: pulumi stack created: pulumi stack init sea4-prod ; config set gcp:project <proj-id> ; added stack reference to TF outputs via config (network_self_link). sample smoke test: kubectl run hello-nginx --image=nginx --replicas=1; kubectl get nodes && kubectl get pods -o wide.

infra-bot: [deploy-bot] pipeline sea4-network apply started by @raj at 2156789123

Raj: small snag: IAM role for node SA needs "compute.attachedDisks" permission else CSI fails. Added role binding in TF module; reapply in CI.

Olivia: quota update: submitted support ticket #78923, mention internal quota owner -> ETA 36 hours. Meanwhile request temporary preemptible A10G for smoke via partners.

Mia: validation checklist draft: - TF apply success, - Pulumi cluster up, - nodepools ready with GPU labels, - k8s CSI + nvidia drivers installed, - smoke job passes, - cost burn estimate <= budget tag, - stack export, - add monitoring dashboards + alert rules. Will paste runbook snippet below.

Mia: runbook snippet:
```
1) Merge TF branch -> CI will run terraform plan
2) Wait for manual approval in pipeline (two approvals required)
3) After TF apply, trigger pulumi pipeline
4) Pulumi will provision cluster, wait for node readiness
5) Run smoke job: ./scripts/cluster-smoke.sh sea4
6) Collect kubelet logs if nodes crash: gcloud compute ssh <node> -- "sudo journalctl -u kubelet | tail -n 200"
7) If GPU driver fails: check DaemonSet events and reinstall driver using our GPU-installer helm chart.
8) Post successful smoke: tag infra:region=sea4, owner=mia, notify #eng-infra
```

Lee: pipeline note: ensure terraform outputs are stored as CI artifacts for pulumi to consume; don't store secrets in artifacts. Use CI variables and GCS-stored TF outputs encrypted.

Jamie: added pulumi autopilot preview check that fails on drift > 5% node count. Also added a post-deploy job to run k8s conformance smoke.

Mia: handoff: once smoke green and quota confirmed, I'll add owners and escalate to platform-ops for 24h watch. tagging and cost alerts configured. Anyone see gaps?

Raj: need to add route for peering to prod-vpc; pinging networking to approve route table entries.

Olivia: I'll follow up on SKU availability with cloud provider rep. If A10G not available, fallback plan: increase T4 count + enable medium quantization for models.

Mia: thanks all. I'll keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:
